name: Cleaving through creatures
author: Alexandria
summary: When a melee attack drops a creature, the leftover damage can carry on to another one in reach.

rules.text: When a **melee attack** reduces an undamaged creature to 0 hit points, any **leftover damage** carries over to another creature within reach, if the same attack roll would hit it.

assistant.dm: Cleave is on: when a melee attack drops an undamaged creature to 0 HP, leftover damage carries to another creature in reach if the same attack roll would hit it. Great with minions.
assistant.player: At this table extra damage from a melee hit that drops a fresh enemy carries over to another enemy in reach, if your attack roll would hit it too.
